chunks: And Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:
When the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was taken on the night journey to the heaven, he said: Jibra'il عليه السلام came to me and said: O Muhammad, indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says:
Indeed, I have forgiven those of your Ummah who practice mut'ah with women.

key_terms.أُسْرِيَ بِهِ: was taken on the night journey

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about Allah's forgiveness for those who practice mut'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement conveyed to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله during the Mi'raj, declaring divine forgiveness for those in his Ummah who engage in mut'ah with women. The report relates to the legal and theological significance of temporary marriage within Shia tradition and presents it in the context of a heavenly communication.
